title.zh: 持续 500 次 ICMP/UDP 探针抗丢包大比拼：42 家机场晚高峰链路抖动（Jitter）详实记录
title.en: Continuous 500-Probe ICMP/UDP Packet Loss Benchmark: 42-Proxy Peak Jitter Audit

cluster.zh: 晚高峰单线程测速天梯集群

description.zh: 晚高峰持续发射 500 次高频 ICMP 与 UDP 数据包，精确实测 42 家主流机场的链路抖动标准差（Jitter）、丢包率与路由器队列溢出缓冲膨胀（Bufferbloat）指标。
description.en: Deploying continuous 500-round ICMP and UDP probes during evening peak hours to measure jitter standard deviation, packet loss ratios, and bufferbloat across 42 proxy brands.
